camel_example: aliyun hbr DescribeClients --region cn-hangzhou --ClientType ECS_AGENT --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmw6bxl7o5qyq' --PageNumber 1 --ClusterId 'cl-0005ni10000002l87' --SourceType HANA --ClientId 'c-000ed6000000006b0' --VaultId 'v-0001vk0z000000xdyr'
description_en: Queries one or more Cloud Backup clients that meet the specified conditions
description_zh: 获取一个或多个符合条件的备份客户端
kebab_example: aliyun hbr describe-clients --vault-id v-0001vk0z000000xdyr --client-id c-000ed6000000006b0 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --client-type ECS_AGENT --source-type HANA --cluster-id cl-0005ni10000002l87 --resource-group-id rg-acfmw6bxl7o5qyq --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeClients

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup vault
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Cloud Backup client
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码，从1开始，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 99. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，最小值为1，最大值为99，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The type of the Cloud Backup client. Valid value: ECS_AGENT, which indicates an SAP HANA backup client
parameters.help_zh: 备份客户端类型。取值为ECS_AGENT，表示SAP HANA备份客户端
parameters.name: client_type

parameters.help_en: The type of the data source. Valid value:HANA, which indicates SAP HANA backup
parameters.help_zh: 数据源类型，取值为HANA，表示SAP HANA备份
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAP HANA instance
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

AlertSetting.description_en: The alert settings. Valid value: INHERITED, which indicates that the Cloud Backup client sends alert notifications by using the same method configured for the backup vault
AlertSetting.description_zh: 告警设置。取值为INHERITED，表示使用与备份库一致的报警方式

ClientId.description_en: The ID of the Cloud Backup client

ClientType.description_en: The type of the Cloud Backup client. Valid value: ECS_AGENT, which indicates an SAP HANA backup client
ClientType.description_zh: 备份客户端类型。取值为ECS_AGENT，表示SAP HANA备份客户端

ClientVersion.description_en: The version number of the Cloud Backup client

ClusterId.description_en: The ID of the SAP HANA instance

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the Cloud Backup client was created

HeartBeatTime.description_en: The latest heartbeat time of the Cloud Backup client. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
HeartBeatTime.description_zh: 客户端心跳时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the ECS instance

MaxVersion.description_en: The maximum version number of the Cloud Backup client

NetworkType.description_en:
The network type. Valid values:

CLASSIC: the classic network
VPC: the virtual private cloud (VPC)
NetworkType.description_zh:
网络类型，返回值包括：
CLASSIC：经典网络。
VPC：专有网络

Status.description_en:
The status of the Cloud Backup client. Valid values:

REGISTERED: The backup client is registered.
ACTIVATED: The backup client is activated.
DEACTIVATED: The backup client fails to be activated.
INSTALLING: The backup client is being installed.
INSTALL_FAILED: The backup client fails to be installed.
NOT_INSTALLED: The backup client is not installed.
UPGRADING: The backup client is being upgraded.
UPGRADE_FAILED: The backup client fails to be upgraded.
UNINSTALLING: The backup client is being uninstalled.
UNINSTALL_FAILED: The backup client fails to be uninstalled.
STOPPED: The backup client is out of service.
UNKNOWN: The backup client is disconnected
Status.description_zh:
备份客户端状态。取值包括：
REGISTERED：注册成功
ACTIVATED：激活成功
DEACTIVATED：激活失效
INSTALLING：安装中
INSTALL_FAILED：安装失败
NOT_INSTALLED：未安装
UPGRADING：升级中
UPGRADE_FAILED：升级失败
UNINSTALLING：卸载客户端中
UNINSTALL_FAILED：卸载客户端失败
STOPPED：客户端服务已停止
UNKNOWN：客户端失联

UpdatedTime.description_en: The time when the Cloud Backup client was updated. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
UpdatedTime.description_zh: 备份客户端更新时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒

UseHttps.description_en:
Indicates whether data is transmitted over HTTPS. Valid values:

true: Data is transmitted over HTTPS.
false: Data is transmitted over HTTP
UseHttps.description_zh:
是否使用HTTPS传输数据。

true表示使用HTTPS传输。
false表示使用HTTP传输

VaultId.description_en: The ID of the backup vault

Code.description_en: The response code. The status code 200 indicates that the request was successful

Message.description_en: The returned message. If the request was successful, "successful" is returned. If the request failed, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

PageNumber.description_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 分页页码，从1开始，默认值为1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 99. Default value: 10
PageSize.description_zh: 分页大小，最小值为1，最大值为99，默认值为10

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：成功
false：失败

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
